# V&A Marketing Agency

> V&A Marketing Agency is a Christian charity marketing agency based in the United Kingdom. We help Christian charities grow through search-led content (SEO), Google Ad Grant management, targeted advertising and membership and community strategy. We build long-term relationships: our average working period with charities is 12 to 24 months.

Charity rates are set by annual income: £30 per hour (under £1m), £36 per hour (£1m to £3m), £50 per hour (over £3m). Contact: info@vamarketingagency.co.uk

## Core pages
- [Charity marketing](https://www.vamarketingagency.co.uk/charity-marketing.html): what charity marketing is, what a strategy includes, our process and FAQs
- [Christian charity digital marketing and Google Ad Grants](https://www.vamarketingagency.co.uk/digital-marketing-for-charities.html): Ad Grant eligibility, setup and management
- [Services](https://www.vamarketingagency.co.uk/services.html): SEO, targeted advertising, Ad Grants, membership and community, and our four-step process
- [Packages and rates](https://www.vamarketingagency.co.uk/packages.html): package prices and hourly rates by charity income
- [Membership and community](https://www.vamarketingagency.co.uk/membership-community.html): moving supporters from awareness to advocacy
- [About](https://www.vamarketingagency.co.uk/about.html): our story and ethos
